# Project Phoenix v55.0 — 1337 Main Mod Provincial-Capital Dynamic War Overhaul (EU5 1.4.9).
# Generated by gen_v550_all_era_dynamic_war_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Location scope: single-location transfer preserving pre-existing cores, setting conquered + 0.20 control otherwise.
oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ownable = yes
			has_owner = yes
			NOT = { owner ?= $recipient$ }
			NOT = { oe_conquest_is_native_civil_war = { recipient = $recipient$ } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_core_of = $recipient$ }
			change_location_owner = $recipient$
			change_location_controller = $recipient$
			change_integration_level = core
		}
		else = {
			change_location_owner = $recipient$
			change_location_controller = $recipient$
			oe_reset_new_conquest_integration = { recipient = $recipient$ }
			change_control = 0.20
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: Provincial-capital direct-ownership seizure for Main Mod 1337 campaigns & pacification wars.
oe_v55_dw_main_seize_province_or_tile = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_v55_dw_main_rule_off }
			is_ownable = yes
			has_owner = yes
			NOT = { owner ?= $recipient$ }
			NOT = { oe_conquest_is_native_civil_war = { recipient = $recipient$ } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_game_rule = oe_v55_dw_main_rule_province_capital
				is_province_capital = yes
				# Human defender protection: AI attackers never whole-province-annex a human player; only the single tile flips.
				OR = {
					owner = { is_ai = yes }
					$recipient$ = { is_ai = no }
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_loc
			owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner }
			province = {
				every_location_in_province = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_loc }
						is_ownable = yes
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner
						NOT = { owner ?= $recipient$ }
					}
					add_to_list = oe_v55_dw_main_prov_batch
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = oe_v55_dw_main_prov_batch
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner
						NOT = { owner ?= $recipient$ }
					}
					oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = { recipient = $recipient$ }
				}
			}
			scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_loc = {
				oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = { recipient = $recipient$ }
			}
			$recipient$ = {
				add_gold = 25
				add_manpower = 0.25
				add_army_tradition = 1.5
			}
			scope:oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
						NOT = { has_or_had_tag = ELR }
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_v55_dw_main_alert_cd }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_v55_dw_main_alert_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v55_dw_main.1
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_single_prev_owner }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = oe_v55_dw_main_rule_province_capital
					is_province_capital = yes
				}
				oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = { recipient = $recipient$ }
				scope:oe_v55_dw_main_single_prev_owner = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							is_ai = no
							is_rebel_country = no
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
							NOT = { has_or_had_tag = ELR }
							num_locations > 0
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_v55_dw_main_alert_cd }
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_v55_dw_main_alert_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v55_dw_main.1
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = { recipient = $recipient$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (root = occupying country, scope:target = occupied provincial capital).
oe_v55_dw_main_execute_cb_seizure = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1337
			has_game_rule = oe_v55_dw_main_rule_province_capital
			is_rebel_country = no
			in_civil_war = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
			NOT = { has_or_had_tag = ELR }
			exists = scope:target
			scope:target = {
				is_ownable = yes
				is_province_capital = yes
				has_owner = yes
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_occupier
		scope:target.owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_occupier }
				is_at_war_with = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner
			}
			every_current_war = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_qual_war }
						is_in_war = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_prev_owner
						oe_v55_dw_main_pacification_cb_war = yes
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_qual_war
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_qual_war
						scope:target = { oe_v55_dw_main_vanilla_upheaval = yes }
					}
				}
				scope:target = {
					oe_v55_dw_main_seize_province_or_tile = { recipient = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_occupier }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (expects scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy and scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war saved by caller).
oe_v55_dw_main_execute_total_capitulation = {
	hidden_effect = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
				scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy = {
					is_ai = yes
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
				}
			}
			scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = capital }
					capital = {
						save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_enemy_cap
						region = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_region }
					}
				}
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = {
						is_ownable = yes
						is_capital = no
						OR = {
							controller ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner
							trigger_if = {
								limit = { exists = controller }
								controller = { is_subject_or_below_of = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner }
							}
							AND = {
								exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_region
								region ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_region
							}
						}
					}
					add_to_list = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_sweep
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_sweep
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
						NOT = { owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner }
					}
					oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = { recipient = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_enemy_cap
					scope:oe_v55_dw_main_enemy_cap = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
						NOT = { owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner }
					}
				}
				scope:oe_v55_dw_main_enemy_cap = {
					oe_v55_dw_main_transfer_one = { recipient = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_winner }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_heg_expedition_reform }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v55_dw_main_tmp_heg_ref value = 1 days = 5 }
				remove_reform = government_reform:oe_heg_expedition_reform
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war
					scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy = { num_locations > 0 }
					is_at_war_with = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
				}
				white_peace = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v55_dw_main_tmp_heg_ref }
				remove_variable = oe_v55_dw_main_tmp_heg_ref
				if = {
					limit = { at_war = no }
					oe_heg_finish_expedition = yes
				}
				else = {
					add_reform = government_reform:oe_heg_expedition_reform
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (expects scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy and scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war saved by caller).
oe_v55_dw_main_execute_vassal_capitulation = {
	hidden_effect = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_vassal_lord
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war
				exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
				is_at_war_with = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
			}
			white_peace = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
				scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy = {
					is_ai = yes
					is_rebel_country = no
					is_subject = no
					num_locations > 0
					subject_type_is_not_locked = yes
					can_make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_vassal_lord
						type = subject_type:vassal
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = { country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire }
						AND = {
							country_rank_level <= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_vassal_lord.country_rank_level
							army_size <= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_vassal_lord.army_size
						}
					}
				}
			}
			scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy = {
				make_subject_of = {
					target = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_vassal_lord
					type = subject_type:vassal
				}
			}
			add_prestige = 12
			add_gold = 100
		}
		else = {
			add_gold = 350
			add_prestige = 15
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: Main Mod 1337 Pacification & Hegemony Decisive Auto-Victory detector.
# Strictly AI defenders only! Human attackers get interactive 3-option oe_v55_dw_main.2; AI attackers execute Option A.
oe_v55_dw_main_check_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1337
			has_game_rule = oe_v55_dw_main_rule_province_capital
			at_war = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
			in_civil_war = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
			NOT = { has_or_had_tag = ELR }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_offer_cd }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v55_dw_cap_offer_cd }
		}
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_victor
		every_current_war = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_found_war }
					NOT = { is_civil_war_for = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor }
					OR = {
						AND = { attacker_leader ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor exists = defender_leader }
						AND = { defender_leader ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor exists = attacker_leader }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { attacker_leader ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor }
					defender_leader = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy }
				}
				else = {
					attacker_leader = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { is_civil_war_for = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy }
						scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy = {
							is_ai = yes
							is_rebel_country = no
							num_locations > 0
							NOT = { this = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor }
							NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor }
						}
						OR = {
							oe_v55_dw_main_pacification_cb_war = yes
							oe_v55_dw_main_heg_campaign_war = yes
							scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_heg_expedition_reform }
							scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy = {
								exists = capital
								capital = { oe_v55_dw_main_vanilla_upheaval = yes }
							}
						}
						scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor = {
							OR = {
								war_score_versus = { target = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy value >= 0.80 }
								AND = {
									war_score_versus = { target = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy value >= 0.65 }
									scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy = {
										exists = capital
										capital = {
											OR = {
												controller ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor
												owner ?= scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor
												trigger_if = {
													limit = { exists = controller }
													controller = { is_subject_or_below_of = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_victor }
												}
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_found_war
					save_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_war
					scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cand_enemy = { save_scope_as = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_found_war
				exists = scope:oe_v55_dw_main_cap_enemy
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v55_dw_main_cap_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
					NOT = { has_or_had_tag = ELR }
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v55_dw_main.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				oe_v55_dw_main_execute_total_capitulation = yes
				add_gold = 150
				add_prestige = 10
				add_army_tradition = 5
			}
		}
	}
}
